<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();

(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();

(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

class="framer-1u9abbw" data-framer-name="Paragraph"><div class="framer-1bnvuyy" data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">AZ Estate Remodel | A 17,000 Sq. Ft. Transformation</h3><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h4><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Home Reimagined from the Inside Out</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This remodel is more than new finishes - it’s a complete spatial and experiential overhaul. The original structure has been stripped back to its bones, giving us the freedom to <strong class="framer-text">reshape circulation, redefine sightlines, and align every detail into one cohesive narrative.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The design direction: a <strong class="framer-text">cottage-inspired warmth</strong> layered with the drama of rare stone, custom woodwork, and a dialed material palette. Think <strong class="framer-text">wooden bases paired with marble finishes</strong>, soft yet sophisticated textures, and warm hues that feel timeless and human.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Where the home once felt like a collection of disconnected rooms, the remodel brings cohesion. Every finish, fixture, and transition is part of a larger orchestration, creating a seamless flow from one experience to the next.</p><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h4><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Iconic Materials as Design Anchors</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">One of the defining elements of this remodel is its use of <strong class="framer-text">rare backlit stone slabs</strong> - iconic materials that will glow with a natural radiance, transforming walls, counters, and feature elements into illuminated art. These pieces are more than finishes; they are <strong class="framer-text">sculptural installations</strong> that define the mood of entire rooms.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Wood + Marble Pairings</strong> — Every base cabinet, millwork element, and built form is crafted in wood and paired with a marble counterpart, creating a dialogue between warmth and refinement.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Palettes</strong> — The color story leans organic: creams, warm greys, honeyed wood tones, and soft charcoals accented by the glow of backlit stone.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Seamless Transitions</strong> — With so many specialty rooms, it was essential to ensure that materials flow harmoniously from one program to the next. Our design team developed a matrix of finishes that tie each room back to the home’s overarching cottage-modern ethos.</p></li></ul><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">The Emotional Core: Warmth Meets Refinement</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Though expansive at 17,000 square feet, the home is grounded in warmth. Our design avoids sterility by layering:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cottage Influences</strong> — Textural woods, warm-toned finishes, and human-scale details that soften the architecture.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Sculptural Stone</strong> — Iconic slabs that elevate without overpowering, always paired with tactile complements.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Curated Lighting</strong> — Layered illumination that creates depth, ambience, and adaptability across spaces.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Holistic Cohesion</strong> — Every transition, every finish, every furnishing aligned to tell one continuous story.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The effect is a home that feels both monumental and deeply livable.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Benchmark in Arizona Luxury</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">In Arizona’s design landscape, this remodel sets a new standard. It blends the region’s love for <strong class="framer-text">indoor-outdoor living</strong> with an unmatched commitment to material quality, program diversity, and cohesive narrative.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Scale with Soul</strong> — Despite its size, the home feels curated and intimate, with each room considered in its own right.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Iconic Elements</strong> — From the glowing slabs to the speakeasy, the home is punctuated by unforgettable moments.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Flow</strong> — Transitions are seamless, ensuring that whether you’re in the basketball court, theatre, or kitchen, the same design DNA is present.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This project proves that <strong class="framer-text">luxury is not excess - it’s cohesion, clarity, and intention.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Architecture of Light</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Arizona landscape, dissolving barriers between interior and exterior. Light floods every room, shifting with the desert sun. At night, backlit stone slabs and custom fixtures create an entirely new mood - warm, inviting, and dramatic.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This duality is essential to the remodel: <strong class="framer-text">by day, a bright and expansive retreat; by night, a glowing, atmospheric sanctuary.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Why NORTH & MERCER</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Transformations of this magnitude require expertise that extends beyond design. At NORTH & MERCER, we bring:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Creative Leadership</strong> — Crafting an overarching vision that ties every decision to a unified narrative.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Sourcing Power</strong> — Procuring rare slabs, custom fixtures, and exclusive furnishings at a national and international level.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Logistical Orchestration</strong> — Coordinating warehousing, delivery, installation, and sequencing across hundreds of moving pieces.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cross-Team Collaboration</strong> — Aligning builders, artisans, subcontractors, and suppliers to preserve design integrity at every stage.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This Arizona estate is not just being remodeled - it’s being <strong class="framer-text">reimagined into an icon of cohesive, material-rich luxury.</strong></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--><div class="framer-4yjyay hidden-o9zibs hidden-z1i0uw hidden-1m9xg4d" data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">AZ Estate Remodel | A 17,000 Sq. Ft. Transformation</h3><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h4><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Home Reimagined from the Inside Out</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This remodel is more than new finishes - it’s a complete spatial and experiential overhaul. The original structure has been stripped back to its bones, giving us the freedom to <strong class="framer-text">reshape circulation, redefine sightlines, and align every detail into one cohesive narrative.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The design direction: a <strong class="framer-text">cottage-inspired warmth</strong> layered with the drama of rare stone, custom woodwork, and a dialed material palette. Think <strong class="framer-text">wooden bases paired with marble finishes</strong>, soft yet sophisticated textures, and warm hues that feel timeless and human.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Where the home once felt like a collection of disconnected rooms, the remodel brings cohesion. Every finish, fixture, and transition is part of a larger orchestration, creating a seamless flow from one experience to the next.</p><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h4><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Iconic Materials as Design Anchors</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">One of the defining elements of this remodel is its use of <strong class="framer-text">rare backlit stone slabs</strong> - iconic materials that will glow with a natural radiance, transforming walls, counters, and feature elements into illuminated art. These pieces are more than finishes; they are <strong class="framer-text">sculptural installations</strong> that define the mood of entire rooms.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Wood + Marble Pairings</strong> — Every base cabinet, millwork element, and built form is crafted in wood and paired with a marble counterpart, creating a dialogue between warmth and refinement.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Palettes</strong> — The color story leans organic: creams, warm greys, honeyed wood tones, and soft charcoals accented by the glow of backlit stone.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Seamless Transitions</strong> — With so many specialty rooms, it was essential to ensure that materials flow harmoniously from one program to the next. Our design team developed a matrix of finishes that tie each room back to the home’s overarching cottage-modern ethos.</p></li></ul><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">The Emotional Core: Warmth Meets Refinement</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Though expansive at 17,000 square feet, the home is grounded in warmth. Our design avoids sterility by layering:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cottage Influences</strong> — Textural woods, warm-toned finishes, and human-scale details that soften the architecture.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Sculptural Stone</strong> — Iconic slabs that elevate without overpowering, always paired with tactile complements.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Curated Lighting</strong> — Layered illumination that creates depth, ambience, and adaptability across spaces.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Holistic Cohesion</strong> — Every transition, every finish, every furnishing aligned to tell one continuous story.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The effect is a home that feels both monumental and deeply livable.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Benchmark in Arizona Luxury</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">In Arizona’s design landscape, this remodel sets a new standard. It blends the region’s love for <strong class="framer-text">indoor-outdoor living</strong> with an unmatched commitment to material quality, program diversity, and cohesive narrative.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Scale with Soul</strong> — Despite its size, the home feels curated and intimate, with each room considered in its own right.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Iconic Elements</strong> — From the glowing slabs to the speakeasy, the home is punctuated by unforgettable moments.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Flow</strong> — Transitions are seamless, ensuring that whether you’re in the basketball court, theatre, or kitchen, the same design DNA is present.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This project proves that <strong class="framer-text">luxury is not excess - it’s cohesion, clarity, and intention.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Architecture of Light</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Arizona landscape, dissolving barriers between interior and exterior. Light floods every room, shifting with the desert sun. At night, backlit stone slabs and custom fixtures create an entirely new mood - warm, inviting, and dramatic.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This duality is essential to the remodel: <strong class="framer-text">by day, a bright and expansive retreat; by night, a glowing, atmospheric sanctuary.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Why NORTH & MERCER</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Transformations of this magnitude require expertise that extends beyond design. Every finish, fixture, and transition is part of a larger orchestration, creating a seamless flow from one experience to the next.</p><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h4><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Iconic Materials as Design Anchors</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">One of the defining elements of this remodel is its use of <strong class="framer-text">rare backlit stone slabs</strong> - iconic materials that will glow with a natural radiance, transforming walls, counters, and feature elements into illuminated art. These pieces are more than finishes; they are <strong class="framer-text">sculptural installations</strong> that define the mood of entire rooms.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Wood + Marble Pairings</strong> — Every base cabinet, millwork element, and built form is crafted in wood and paired with a marble counterpart, creating a dialogue between warmth and refinement.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Palettes</strong> — The color story leans organic: creams, warm greys, honeyed wood tones, and soft charcoals accented by the glow of backlit stone.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Seamless Transitions</strong> — With so many specialty rooms, it was essential to ensure that materials flow harmoniously from one program to the next. Our design team developed a matrix of finishes that tie each room back to the home’s overarching cottage-modern ethos.</p></li></ul><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">The Emotional Core: Warmth Meets Refinement</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Though expansive at 17,000 square feet, the home is grounded in warmth. Our design avoids sterility by layering:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cottage Influences</strong> — Textural woods, warm-toned finishes, and human-scale details that soften the architecture.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Sculptural Stone</strong> — Iconic slabs that elevate without overpowering, always paired with tactile complements.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Curated Lighting</strong> — Layered illumination that creates depth, ambience, and adaptability across spaces.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Holistic Cohesion</strong> — Every transition, every finish, every furnishing aligned to tell one continuous story.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The effect is a home that feels both monumental and deeply livable.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Benchmark in Arizona Luxury</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">In Arizona’s design landscape, this remodel sets a new standard. It blends the region’s love for <strong class="framer-text">indoor-outdoor living</strong> with an unmatched commitment to material quality, program diversity, and cohesive narrative.</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Scale with Soul</strong> — Despite its size, the home feels curated and intimate, with each room considered in its own right.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Iconic Elements</strong> — From the glowing slabs to the speakeasy, the home is punctuated by unforgettable moments.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Cohesive Flow</strong> — Transitions are seamless, ensuring that whether you’re in the basketball court, theatre, or kitchen, the same design DNA is present.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This project proves that <strong class="framer-text">luxury is not excess - it’s cohesion, clarity, and intention.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Architecture of Light</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Arizona landscape, dissolving barriers between interior and exterior. Light floods every room, shifting with the desert sun. At night, backlit stone slabs and custom fixtures create an entirely new mood - warm, inviting, and dramatic.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This duality is essential to the remodel: <strong class="framer-text">by day, a bright and expansive retreat; by night, a glowing, atmospheric sanctuary.</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Why NORTH & MERCER</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Transformations of this magnitude require expertise that extends beyond design.       preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>
<!-- SnippetEnd: GUCDpflMA -->

    <!-- End of bodyEnd -->
</body>
</html>

class="framer-1u9abbw" data-framer-name="Paragraph"><div class="framer-1bnvuyy" data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Inside a Full-Scale Luxury Remodel at Gozzer Ranch</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Tucked along the shores of Lake Coeur d’Alene, <strong class="framer-text">Gozzer Ranch</strong> is one of Idaho’s most prestigious private communities - where the views are dramatic, the golf is world-class, and the homes are nothing short of iconic. But even in a place built for luxury, not every property starts off with soul.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">When our client purchased a home in Gozzer Ranch, it had all the square footage and structural potential - but none of the character. The interiors were a cold, impersonal <strong class="framer-text">“white box,”</strong> lacking warmth, cohesion, or a sense of identity. Our client needed more than furniture. They needed a transformation. One that reflected the landscape, elevated the space, and made the house feel like a home.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">That’s where NORTH & MERCER came in.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">A Blank Canvas With a Million-Dollar View</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The original interiors were stripped down and sterile. White walls, basic finishes, zero storytelling. While the structure had good bones, the home lacked contrast, texture, and most importantly, connection to its stunning natural surroundings. Our job was to <strong class="framer-text">bring it to life</strong>.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From the first walkthrough, our team envisioned a complete <strong class="framer-text">reimagining</strong> of the home, inside and out. The goal wasn’t just to decorate. It was to <strong class="framer-text">redefine how the space functioned, felt, and flowed</strong>. And with a client who trusted our vision, we were given the freedom to deliver something truly elevated.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Interior Transformation: Elevating Every Inch</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Custom Concept, Tailored Execution</strong></p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Our process began with <strong class="framer-text">space planning and storytelling.</strong> We interviewed the client, studied the property, and created a design direction that layered <strong class="framer-text">earthy tones, refined finishes, and a balance of rustic elegance and modern ease.</strong> The Gozzer Ranch aesthetic calls for sophistication without pretension, and our design reflected that ethos perfectly.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">We implemented:</h5><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Custom wall treatments</strong> to add depth and mood to formerly flat walls</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Refinished flooring and ceiling details</strong> to frame each space with architectural weight</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Bespoke built-ins and millwork</strong> that created function without clutter</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Textural fabrics and warm leathers</strong> for furnishings that invite, not intimidate</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From a once-bland great room, we carved out <strong class="framer-text">a layered living experience</strong> that opened to the outdoors and mirrored the organic palette of the Idaho mountainscape.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Kitchen &amp; Bath Revivals</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">In the kitchen, we removed generic cabinetry and replaced it with <strong class="framer-text">custom-crafted woodwork, matte stone surfaces, and designer hardware</strong>. We incorporated open shelving and hidden storage, creating a space that was both curated and practical.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Bathrooms were transformed with:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Natural stone vanities</strong></p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Backlit mirrors</strong></p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Artisan tilework</strong></p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Spa-inspired lighting</strong></p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No room was left untouched. Every finish, fixture, and furnishing was chosen with intention, and nothing came straight out of a catalog.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Full-Service Procurement</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Thanks to our in-house <strong class="framer-text">furniture store, materials SHOP, and warehouse</strong>, we handled everything from <strong class="framer-text">custom upholstery</strong> to <strong class="framer-text">hand-delivered lighting</strong>. With access to over <strong class="framer-text">250 vendor lines</strong>, we were able to create a home filled with exclusive pieces you can’t find in retail stores.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Our procurement team managed:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Order tracking</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Vendor coordination</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Consolidated delivery</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">White-glove installation</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The result? A home that feels <strong class="framer-text">entirely custom and effortlessly cohesive</strong>, without the client needing to manage a single shipment.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Exterior Overhaul: Curb Appeal With Context</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">A stunning interior deserves a landscape to match. The original exterior felt like an afterthought. Basic turf, uninspired beds, and no intentional flow between outdoor zones.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">NORTH & MERCER partnered with landscape designers and contractors to <strong class="framer-text">reimagine the exterior</strong> from the ground up. Our landscape transformation included:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Expanded patios</strong> for seamless indoor-outdoor entertaining</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Natural stone pathways</strong> and seating nooks</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Native plantings</strong> that celebrate the region while softening architectural lines</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><strong class="framer-text">Fire pit zones</strong> and lighting features for four-season enjoyment</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We also introduced <strong class="framer-text">privacy-enhancing layouts</strong> without compromising the home’s panoramic views of Lake Coeur d’Alene and the surrounding hills.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006">Why NORTH & MERCER Was the Right Fit</h4><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Projects like this aren’t about furniture. data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Inside a Full-Scale Luxury Remodel at Gozzer Ranch</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Tucked along the shores of Lake Coeur d’Alene, <strong class="framer-text">Gozzer Ranch</strong> is one of Idaho’s most prestigious private communities - where the views are dramatic, the golf is world-class, and the homes are nothing short of iconic. But even in a place built for luxury, not every property starts off with soul.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">When our client purchased a home in Gozzer Ranch, it had all the square footage and structural potential - but none of the character. They needed a transformation. (function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();

class="framer-1u9abbw" data-framer-name="Paragraph"><div class="framer-1bnvuyy" data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Designing Without Borders: How NORTH & MERCER Delivered on Arizona's Most Expensive Home</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">When it comes to luxury design, few places capture imagination quite like Paradise Valley, Arizona, a desert enclave where elegance meets edge, and expectations run sky-high. At NORTH & MERCER, we were honored to contribute to one of the most ambitious residential projects in Arizona history: a 23,000-square-foot estate that recently closed for <strong class="framer-text">$33.5 million</strong>, becoming the <strong class="framer-text">most expensive home ever sold in the state</strong>.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The home spans nearly 2.5 acres and includes six bedrooms, 13.5 bathrooms, and some of the most jaw-dropping features we’ve ever integrated into a private residence, including a <strong class="framer-text">safe room connected to a shooting range, basement lounge, and full bar</strong>. But the real story behind the home isn’t just its scale, it’s how we made it happen from over 1,300 miles away.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">More Than Just Designers</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">NORTH & MERCER isn’t your average interior design firm. Yes, we conceptualize spaces. We also procure, warehouse, manage logistics, and execute projects from coast to coast (and beyond). We’re designers, but we’re also supply chain strategists, material experts, and trusted collaborators for builders and developers. That’s exactly what projects like this demand.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From <strong class="framer-text">Scottsdale and Paradise Valley</strong> to clients across the U.S. and internationally, our team specializes in <strong class="framer-text">designing high-end spaces remotely</strong> while offering the service, structure, and sophistication of a hands-on local firm. This latest Arizona project showcased the full scope of what we do, and what sets us apart.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The home was featured on the cover of Builder Magazine January 2025 edition. It has also been featured in numerous news outlets and design features.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Seamless Design at Scale</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From the beginning, this Paradise Valley estate called for precision, clarity, and vision. The architectural bones were bold and contemporary, which meant our design approach had to strike a careful balance: modern, but warm. Sophisticated, but functional. Luxe, but livable.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We partnered closely with the builder reviewing layouts, lighting plans, material specs, and more. Because of the sheer size and detail of the home, design decisions couldn’t be made on instinct alone. Every room required a strategy. Every finish had to layer beautifully with the next.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">To ensure alignment, we produced detailed 3D renderings, comprehensive mood boards, and virtual walkthroughs. Every piece of furniture, lighting fixture, and hardware component was reviewed through our <strong class="framer-text">client-first process</strong>, refined for cohesion, and tracked through our <strong class="framer-text">in-house procurement team</strong>.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Procurement Is Our Superpower</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">One of the biggest value-adds we bring to large-scale projects like this isn’t just creative - it’s logistical.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Because NORTH & MERCER has its own <strong class="framer-text">warehouse</strong>, <strong class="framer-text">furniture store</strong>, <strong class="framer-text">SHOP</strong> (for materials and fixtures), and a procurement team that handles hundreds of vendors, we were able to <strong class="framer-text">consolidate, quality-check, and manage</strong> every order tied to this project, down to the last drawer pull.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">That means:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No shipping delays caused by scattered sources.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No vendor confusion about lead times or finishes.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No surprise costs for the client.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No lost items in the chaos of construction.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From flooring and tile to bespoke furniture and one-of-a-kind fixtures, our infrastructure allowed us to operate like an on-site team without being on-site every day.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Why Arizona Projects Are a Perfect Fit</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Arizona homes, especially in the Paradise Valley and Scottsdale area, invite a level of ambition we love to meet. The architectural lines are bold. The palettes are dynamic. And the clients are passionate about creating something one-of-a-kind.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This particular home pushed every boundary in the best way, from underground entertainment zones to spa-level bathrooms. Every room was designed to feel connected, yet distinct. Every detail reflected not just luxury, but intention.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We don’t believe in copy-paste design. Every NORTH & MERCER project is built from the ground up. Rooted in the client’s lifestyle, the architecture’s potential, and our commitment to seamless execution. In Arizona, that mindset thrives.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Our National &amp; International Capabilities</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">While our flagship showroom and operations hub are in Sandpoint, Idaho, we regularly work with clients across the country and internationally. Whether we're helping furnish a Montana ranch, a Manhattan penthouse, or a European getaway, our process makes remote design feel effortless:</p><h6 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-prlkbm">1. Virtual Collaboration, Real Design</h6><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We start with in-depth digital consultations, then present interactive design decks, material samples, and renderings, all tailored to your space.</p><h6 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-prlkbm">2. Full-Service Procurement</h6><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">With over 250+ vendors, we source everything from major furnishings to finishing details, and we manage the entire backend.</p><h6 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-prlkbm">3. Logistics &amp; White Glove Delivery</h6><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We warehouse items until your project is ready, then coordinate shipping and install wherever your property is located.</p><h6 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-prlkbm">4. Builder &amp; Architect Alignment</h6><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We speak construction. We partner fluently with GCs, trades, and architects to ensure timelines and design decisions stay in sync.</p><h4 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-fcx006">What You Get When You Work with NORTH & MERCER</h4><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Design that tells your story.<br class="framer-text"> We don’t do cookie-cutter. data-framer-name="Rich Text 1" data-framer-component-type="RichTextContainer" style="transform:none"><h3 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-1vyulum">Designing Without Borders: How NORTH & MERCER Delivered on Arizona's Most Expensive Home</h3><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">When it comes to luxury design, few places capture imagination quite like Paradise Valley, Arizona, a desert enclave where elegance meets edge, and expectations run sky-high. At NORTH & MERCER, we were honored to contribute to one of the most ambitious residential projects in Arizona history: a 23,000-square-foot estate that recently closed for <strong class="framer-text">$33.5 million</strong>, becoming the <strong class="framer-text">most expensive home ever sold in the state</strong>.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The home spans nearly 2.5 acres and includes six bedrooms, 13.5 bathrooms, and some of the most jaw-dropping features we’ve ever integrated into a private residence, including a <strong class="framer-text">safe room connected to a shooting range, basement lounge, and full bar</strong>. But the real story behind the home isn’t just its scale, it’s how we made it happen from over 1,300 miles away.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">More Than Just Designers</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">NORTH & MERCER isn’t your average interior design firm. Yes, we conceptualize spaces. We also procure, warehouse, manage logistics, and execute projects from coast to coast (and beyond). We’re designers, but we’re also supply chain strategists, material experts, and trusted collaborators for builders and developers. That’s exactly what projects like this demand.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From <strong class="framer-text">Scottsdale and Paradise Valley</strong> to clients across the U.S. and internationally, our team specializes in <strong class="framer-text">designing high-end spaces remotely</strong> while offering the service, structure, and sophistication of a hands-on local firm. This latest Arizona project showcased the full scope of what we do, and what sets us apart.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">The home was featured on the cover of Builder Magazine January 2025 edition. It has also been featured in numerous news outlets and design features.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Seamless Design at Scale</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From the beginning, this Paradise Valley estate called for precision, clarity, and vision. The architectural bones were bold and contemporary, which meant our design approach had to strike a careful balance: modern, but warm. Sophisticated, but functional. Luxe, but livable.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">We partnered closely with the builder reviewing layouts, lighting plans, material specs, and more. Because of the sheer size and detail of the home, design decisions couldn’t be made on instinct alone. Every room required a strategy. Every finish had to layer beautifully with the next.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">To ensure alignment, we produced detailed 3D renderings, comprehensive mood boards, and virtual walkthroughs. Every piece of furniture, lighting fixture, and hardware component was reviewed through our <strong class="framer-text">client-first process</strong>, refined for cohesion, and tracked through our <strong class="framer-text">in-house procurement team</strong>.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Procurement Is Our Superpower</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">One of the biggest value-adds we bring to large-scale projects like this isn’t just creative - it’s logistical.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Because NORTH & MERCER has its own <strong class="framer-text">warehouse</strong>, <strong class="framer-text">furniture store</strong>, <strong class="framer-text">SHOP</strong> (for materials and fixtures), and a procurement team that handles hundreds of vendors, we were able to <strong class="framer-text">consolidate, quality-check, and manage</strong> every order tied to this project, down to the last drawer pull.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">That means:</p><ul dir="auto" class="framer-text"><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No shipping delays caused by scattered sources.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No vendor confusion about lead times or finishes.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No surprise costs for the client.</p></li><li data-preset-tag="p" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5"><p class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">No lost items in the chaos of construction.</p></li></ul><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">From flooring and tile to bespoke furniture and one-of-a-kind fixtures, our infrastructure allowed us to operate like an on-site team without being on-site every day.</p><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></h5><h5 dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-k1n670">Why Arizona Projects Are a Perfect Fit</h5><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">Arizona homes, especially in the Paradise Valley and Scottsdale area, invite a level of ambition we love to meet. And the clients are passionate about creating something one-of-a-kind.</p><p dir="auto" class="framer-text framer-styles-preset-5khja5">This particular home pushed every boundary in the best way, from underground entertainment zones to spa-level bathrooms. <script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal) return;
  window.__autoChangedVimeoFinal = true;

  const ITEMS = [
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1179897283?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/fEDFei8jk6s8UVtIPUEnD43fQ.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    },
    {
      video: "https://player.vimeo.com/video/1165654043?background=1&autoplay=1&loop=1&muted=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0",
      preview: "https://framerusercontent.com/images/TV57ASsNoHjvVBxkMNoXXwoigA.jpg?width=1920&height=1080",
    }
  ];

  const STORAGE_KEY = "auto-changed-video-index-final";

  function getNextItem() {
    try {
      const previousIndexRaw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const previousIndex = previousIndexRaw ? parseInt(previousIndexRaw, 10) : -1;
      const nextIndex =
        Number.isFinite(previousIndex) && previousIndex >= 0
          ? (previousIndex + 1) % ITEMS.length
          : 0;

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(nextIndex));
      return ITEMS[nextIndex];
    } catch (e) {
      return ITEMS[0];
    }
  }

  function buildIframe(url, onLoad) {
    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.src = url;
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "0";
    iframe.style.display = "block";
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";
    iframe.setAttribute("allowfullscreen", "");
    iframe.setAttribute("title", "Vimeo video");
    iframe.onload = onLoad;
    return iframe;
  }

  function mountAllAutoVideos() {
    const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-auto-vimeo-slot="true"]');
    if (!slots.length) return;

    const selected = getNextItem();

    slots.forEach((slot) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted === "true") return;

      const wrap = slot.parentElement;
      const preview = wrap?.querySelector('[data-auto-vimeo-preview="true"]');

      if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = `url("${selected.preview}")`;
        preview.style.opacity = "1";
      }

      slot.innerHTML = "";
      slot.appendChild(
        buildIframe(selected.video, () => {
          if (preview instanceof HTMLElement) {
            preview.style.transition = "opacity 0.35s ease";
            preview.style.opacity = "0";
            preview.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }
        })
      );

      slot.dataset.autoVimeoMounted = "true";
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mountAllAutoVideos, { once: true });
  } else {
    mountAllAutoVideos();
  }
})();
</script>
